Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.
None present for the petitioners to press this present petition even in the revised call.
2. Learned AGA for the State is present.

3. This writ petition has been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 08.07.2023 in Case Crime No. 0184 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 354(kha) IPC and 3/4 D.P.
